brief: Holds one metric name over declared labels, with one child metric for every combination of label values and a bound on how many.
detail: A family such as http.checkout.ms with labels route and method gives each combination its own child with its own percentiles: Child(["/menu", "GET"]).Record(12.5). The registry of children lives in the engine, so a child created after the server copied its monitor is reached by every copy. Cardinality is bounded by design: when the family is full, new label sets are routed to a reserved overflow child whose labels are all _overflow, so data is never dropped and a growing overflow bucket shows in the exposition. The overflow child takes one of the slots from birth, so HasOverflowed answers 1 for a new family. A family has no single value, mean or percentile: ask a child. PromText and OtelMetricJson write one metric with every child.
